verdict.rationale: Square documents a payment flow: card payments, the Web Payments SDK, a payments sandbox, idempotency and an API Explorer for testing requests. Its TypeScript/Node SDK shows copy-paste snippets for client setup and `client.payments.create`. However, only one language's examples are evidenced, and nothing shows a working end-to-end flow built in under a day. missing for 10: copy-paste examples in languages beyond TypeScript/Node, an end-to-end quickstart with full code, independent or hands-on reports of time-to-first-payment, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
